facts.fact: Kunal marks the petition margin with a day count: the hill council fixed the date at Garh Neshar for Shilak's thaw council as thirty-five days off; at this chapter it is day twenty with fifteen left.
facts.why: needed because the outline beat requires the day count 'twenty of thirty-five' with the thaw council after.

facts.fact: Pritam told Kunal the story of Udai at supper the winter Kunal was nine, a week after his father's funeral: Udai showed the way once to one guest in winter and 'was not the same man after'; 'The way kills those who share it.' Pritam made the family rule that night: no prince shows the way to wife, son or friend. Kunal does not know the guest died.
facts.why: needed because the beat has Pritam tell the story as a lesson and make the rule himself.

facts.fact: Pritam took Kunal at twelve to the first turn of the princes' way at the Eye, turned him round himself, and said the rest was for a prince who had earned it.
facts.why: needed because the beat says Kunal has never been past the first turn because his uncle never took him further.

facts.fact: Hill name 'Where the Drum Answers' is the long seam at the cliff foot of the Drum where the ice rings; the saying is 'Where the Drum answers, lie still till morning.'
facts.why: needed because the beat's name trade gives this name.

facts.fact: Hill people call the third lake the Eye; the cleft at its head is its pupil.
facts.why: needed because the beat names the Eye as the third lake where the way enters.
